title: Mexican Masarepa Patties
description: A traditional Mexican dish made from masarepa, a type of cornmeal. These patties are great as a snack or side dish.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, mix together the masarepa and water until well combined.
2. Add the chopped onion and mix until the onion is evenly distributed.
3. Stir in the pilaf and olives.
4. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
5. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture into the skillet and flatten slightly.
6. Cook the patties for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are crispy and golden brown.
